title: botrychium dissectum var. oneidense
intro: Botrychium dissectum var. oneidense, commonly known as Oneida fern, is a rare and unique species of fern that belongs to the Ophioglossaceae family. It is primarily used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oneida fern are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Botrychium dissectum var. oneidense include isopimarinone, 9-acetoxy-7,8-dihydroisopimarinone, and other polyhydroxy lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
